policy.official_reference_use: A human-reviewed official link is usable within its recorded scope after checking publisher, source identity, language, displayed date/version or cutoff, relevant content, and visible limits. No local capture, conversion, hash, or replay is required for ordinary link use.
policy.local_artifact_acceptance: Fourteen accepted local source texts are recorded: eight Service Public/DILA guidance, procedure-directory and administration-directory records; four DILA LEGI statutory texts under Licence Ouverte 2.0; one CNIL guidance text reproduction under CC BY-ND 4.0 FR; and one Conseil d’État court-source guide under its public-information reuse terms. fr-conseil-etat-450285-450288-2022.version_or_cutoff: Joined decision nos. 450285 and 450288, 24 February 2022; follow-up decision no. 450285, 2 February 2024, after CJEU judgment C-143/22.

fr-conseil-etat-450285-450288-2022.reviewed_content: The 2022 decision partially annulled CESEDA Articles L. 233-1 and L. 233-2 insofar as they excluded a dependent child of an EU citizen's spouse who was not that citizen's direct descendant, and partially annulled L. 554-1 on access to work for Dublin-transfer asylum applicants; it stayed the L. 332-3 issue pending the CJEU. The official 2024 follow-up (https://www.conseil-etat.fr/fr/arianeweb/CE/decision/2024-02-02/450285) followed CJEU judgment C-143/22 and partially annulled the second sentence of L. 332-3 insofar as it was not limited to readmission under a pre-13 January 2009 agreement or arrangement.
limitations: The original 2022 www.conseil-etat.fr URL returned 404; the official non-www ArianeWeb URL recorded here was opened successfully. The 2024 follow-up is separately linked in the reviewed-content note.
These decisions concern specific provisions of the 2020 CESEDA recodification. Check the current consolidated CESEDA and CJEU judgment C-143/22 for date-sensitive use.

fr-ceseda-book-ii-legislative.scope: Maintained summary and section map for legislative CESEDA Book II, Articles L. 200-1 to L. 286-2, covering EU citizens, assimilated nationals, family/private ties, entry, residence, removal and territorial adaptations.
fr-ceseda-book-ii-legislative.reviewed_content: Exact official section opened. Reviewed its title, article range, version header and table of contents; statutory definitions in L. 200-1 to L. 200-6; entry and stay rules; residence beyond three months; L. 233-1/L. 233-2 with the 2022 Conseil d'État partial-annulment annotation; permanent residence; removal/litigation; and overseas provisions.
fr-ceseda-book-ii-legislative.reuse: Independently authored and attributed summary. DILA makes Légifrance legal data available for reuse; the official open-data/API page applies Licence Ouverte 2.0 to stable API data. No verbatim code text is reproduced.
limitations: The local Markdown is a summary, not a verbatim statutory copy or English translation.
Read L. 233-1 and L. 233-2 with Conseil d'État decisions nos. 450285/450288 and the 2024 follow-up after CJEU C-143/22.
Use the regulatory Book II, applicable EU instruments and cross-referenced procedural codes for implementation.
The section URL is unpinned; confirm current section and article-level dates before date-sensitive use.

conversion_rules: Preserve LEGITEXT ID, title, official URL, repository commit/path, snapshot date, status and language.
